newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Formosa to expand carbon fibre production.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Formosa to expand carbon fibre production.

text.p: Taiwan's Formosa Plastics Corp said on Friday it would invest T$3 billion to expand carbon fibre production to as much as 4,000 tonnes a year.
"We will invest T$3 billion over three years to boost our carbon fiber production capacity," a Formosa official said.
"The plan will boost production capacity to up to 4,000 tonnes from 500 tonnes per year now," he added.

A new plant would be built in central Yunlin county, where Formosa's parent Formosa group -- Taiwan's largest industrial enterprise -- is building a US$9 billion petrochemical complex around its sixth naphtha cracker, he said.
The expansion would make Formosa the world's leading carbon fibre producer, local media reported.
Formosa group launched the Yunlin project in 1993 and its main products will include ethylene, with anticipated annual capacity of 1.35 million tonnes.
Formosa Group has three key members: Formosa Plastics, Nan Ya Plastics and Formosa Chemical and Fiber.
